notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.13.42.

Works through a Wi-Fi / internet break + Delivery Customers
- Waiters can keep working with no connection: new orders, kitchen slips, customer copies and the final bill are saved on the waiter phone and go through (and print) automatically when the POS is reachable again
- A banner shows "No connection" and how many items are waiting; tables with a waiting bill are marked
- Prints that fail (KOT, bills, cancel slips) are no longer lost: saved on the admin phone and printed again automatically, oldest first, when the printer is back
- Delivery Customers (admin): see orders, total spent and last order for each customer; filters Top spenders and Not ordered for 30+ days; delivery history and favourite dishes inside each customer
